dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: P4/mmm four-site ordered tetragonal fcc-derived Nb3Ti source phase, one Ti and three Nb sites; not A15 Nb3X or disordered bcc Nb-Ti
candidate.prototype_evidence: P4/mmm four-site ordered tetragonal fcc-derived Nb3Ti source phase, one Ti and three Nb sites; not A15 Nb3X or disordered bcc Nb-Ti
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: The exact ordered source has positive Gamma optical compression and no signed negative sampled-path value; fine full max stress is 0.142 GPa. The central competition is known disordered bcc Nb-Ti versus this ordered tetragonal/fcc-derived phase, not an assumption that the experimental alloy validates this ordering. Antisite/phase conversion, SOC and fine residual stress can change the result. Current source local stability is positive finite-grid evidence, not a bulk equilibrium certificate.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.096 GPa, full max stress=0.142 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Nb replaces the three Ta sites as a whole-element construction with complete ordered role mapping across all three symmetry tolerances. Volume contracts 0.5332%, Nb-Nb versus Ta-Ta falls 0.0050234 A; all ten lambda values rise 11.164–18.705% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 17.938 to 22.733 K. Retained single-site Mo/W controls have larger gains, while the Ta single edit has mixed signs; no global ranking or all-three-route conjunction is claimed.
candidate.next_action: Compare the source ordered tetragonal basin with a same-composition disordered/bcc competitor at matched method and a controlled ordering or distortion path. Retained positive pairing response and local stability support the source-phase screen; barrierless conversion or erased response oppose it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Nb replaces the three Ta sites as a whole-element construction with complete ordered role mapping across all three symmetry tolerances. Volume contracts 0.5332%, Nb-Nb versus Ta-Ta falls 0.0050234 A; all ten lambda values rise 11.164–18.705% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 17.938 to 22.733 K. Retained single-site Mo/W controls have larger gains, while the Ta single edit has mixed signs; no global ranking or all-three-route conjunction is claimed.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.096 GPa, full max stress=0.142 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: The exact ordered source has positive Gamma optical compression and no signed negative sampled-path value; fine full max stress is 0.142 GPa. The central competition is known disordered bcc Nb-Ti versus this ordered tetragonal/fcc-derived phase, not an assumption that the experimental alloy validates this ordering. Antisite/phase conversion, SOC and fine residual stress can change the result. Current source local stability is positive finite-grid evidence, not a bulk equilibrium certificate.
seven_criteria.novelty: Commercial superconducting Nb-Ti is well known, and ordered NbTi/Nb3Ti calculations are also prior. Dated exact P4/mmm Nb3Ti queries did not find an experimental superconducting exact ordered phase. The hypothesis is this source ordering and matched Nb-for-Ta construction at finite-grid scalar approximation, not new Nb-Ti chemistry or inherited bcc alloy Tc.
seven_criteria.decision: Compare the source ordered tetragonal basin with a same-composition disordered/bcc competitor at matched method and a controlled ordering or distortion path. Retained positive pairing response and local stability support the source-phase screen; barrierless conversion or erased response oppose it.
